Atom Computing has secured a $100 million research and development award from the U.S. Department of Commerce to accelerate the creation of fault‑tolerant, utility‑scale quantum computing systems. The grant is intended to fund R&D that will enable scalable, reliable quantum processors for commercial applications, underscoring federal investment in national quantum technology leadership.
